query: Does aspirin primary prevention reduce cardiovascular mortality in adults over 70?

pubmed.title: ASPREE: aspirin did not reduce cardiovascular mortality in healthy elderly
pubmed.summary: In adults aged 70 years or older without cardiovascular disease, low-dose aspirin did not significantly reduce cardiovascular mortality compared with placebo and increased major haemorrhage.

openalex.title: Older meta-analysis suggesting aspirin mortality benefit in primary prevention
openalex.summary: A 2010 pooled analysis suggested low-dose aspirin reduced cardiovascular mortality in primary prevention cohorts including older adults. Subsequent large trials have challenged this conclusion.

cochrane.title: Cochrane: mixed aspirin primary-prevention mortality findings
cochrane.summary: Evidence on aspirin for primary prevention shows conflicting mortality findings across eras; ASPREE found no cardiovascular mortality benefit in adults ≥70.

recorded_brief:
## Key Findings
- ASPREE found no cardiovascular mortality benefit for aspirin in adults ≥70.
- An older meta-analysis reported a mortality benefit.

## Bottom Line
- Evidence is mixed across eras.
